# LEAF Wraparound

> Love-based, trauma-responsive wraparound services for adoptive families in California, at no out-of-pocket cost to Adoption Assistance Program (AAP) families. A program of Parents in Training Inc., grounded in the Fear to Love methodology.

LEAF Wraparound helps adoptive families stay together through education, family coaching, parent groups, and in-home support across 20+ California counties. No referral is required: if your adopted child is under 18 and your family receives AAP benefits, you likely qualify automatically. The program operates only within California.

## Core pages
- [Our Program](https://leafwraparound.com/our-program): The wraparound model, its four phases (Engagement, Plan Development, Implementation, Transition), eligibility criteria, and the 20+ California counties served.
- [About LEAF Wraparound](https://leafwraparound.com/about-us): Mission, vision, core values (Love, Integrity, Relationship, Responsibility, Effort), and the organization's philosophy.
- [Our Team](https://leafwraparound.com/our-team): Clinical and program leadership, including founder Jeanette Yoffe, M.A., M.F.T.
- [Our Impact](https://leafwraparound.com/impact): 500+ families supported, 1,200+ children served, 15,000+ hours of care — real stories and outcomes.
- [FAQ](https://leafwraparound.com/faq): Eligibility, cost, High Fidelity Wraparound explanation, counties served, and how to get started.
- [Contact](https://leafwraparound.com/contact-us): Reach the LEAF team in Sacramento, CA for support, referrals, or partnership inquiries.

## Resources & Events
- [Resource Hub](https://leafwraparound.com/resource-hub): Free guides, books, recorded webinars, and tools for adoptive parents on trauma-informed parenting.
- [Events & Webinars](https://leafwraparound.com/events): Upcoming free webinars and workshops for adoptive families in California.
- [Blog](https://leafwraparound.com/blog): Articles on trauma-responsive parenting, adoption challenges, and the Fear to Love methodology.

## Get Involved
- [Careers](https://leafwraparound.com/career): Open roles for wraparound facilitators, clinicians, and parent partners.
- [Donate](https://leafwraparound.com/donate): Support LEAF Wraparound's mission to keep adoptive families together.
